title: Find the median from a data stream
statement: Implement MedianFinder with add_num(x) and find_median() (a float: the middle value, or the mean of the two middle values).
hints: Split the numbers into a lower half and an upper half.
Max-heap for the lower half, min-heap for the upper; keep their sizes within one.

solution.explanation: Two heaps: a max-heap holds the smaller half and a min-heap the larger half, with every lower element ≤ every upper element and sizes differing by at most one. The median is at the tops. To add: push into the lower heap, move its max to the upper heap, and if the upper is now larger, move its min back. The same structure gives sliding-window medians (with lazy deletion) and "balance two groups" problems.
